g.text: What it shows: the automation share within each occupation group, against the 48.6% global average. The published split is

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: a single number for all of Claude; this is the same measure held at the grain where it varies. 14 groups shown, each with

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Anthropic's published Economic Index data documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Deviation from the global average, in percentage points. Computer and Mathematical work is the most automated and Legal the least,

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: which is the shape of a model that is strong at bounded technical tasks and used as a collaborator where judgement and voice carry

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: the work. Automation is a property of the conversation, not evidence of a job displaced. Claude.ai covers the Free, Pro and Max

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: consumer plans plus Cowork; Anthropic's API traffic is a separate file and is not included here.
